# T4.08: registered through the Metal plugin

- **Plugin change** (the user's fork `vendor/nvidia-macos-driver`, branch `nvenc-pre-blackwell`, commit 5efa485; as a
  patch `guest/nvenc/0004-plugin-NVMTL_NVENC_IMPL-nvenc-...patch` in kvm-tahoe-nvidia, commit there too; neither
  pushed): with `NVMTL_NVENC_IMPL=nvenc` in nvrm610.conf, `nvmtl_nvenc_register()` loads `libnvencvt.dylib` from the
  codec library directory (`NVMTLDriver.bundle/Contents/MacOS`) and calls `NVEncVT_Register(1000)` instead of
  registering `libnvenc_h264`; if that fails it falls back to `libnvenc_h264`. The existing per-process knob
  `NVMTL_NVENC_FORCE` still decides which processes get an NVENC encoder at all. Without the new knob nothing changes.
- `libnvencvt.dylib` registers itself only when injected with `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES`; loaded by the plugin, the
  plugin registers it.
- Build check first: kvm-tahoe-nvidia's `build-plugin.sh` (v2.3.1 + 0001-0003) reproduces the installed plugin: same
  `__text` and `__cstring` as the installed 6a474bb3 (only the signature differs). Then built with 0004.
- **Installed in the guest** (`install-plugin.sh patched`, plugin dc2c8170 → bundle-signed 701c20ae;
  `libnvencvt.dylib` into `Contents/MacOS`; knob `NVMTL_NVENC_IMPL=nvenc`). Lesson: the linker's ad-hoc signature on
  the dylib isn't enough for the bundle (`codesign -v`: "code has no resources but signature indicates they must be
  present"); `codesign -f -s -` the dylib, then re-sign the bundle → "bundle signature ok". Rollback:
  `install-plugin.sh restore`, or `install-plugin.sh knob NVMTL_NVENC_IMPL=` to keep the plugin and use nullmoth's encoder.
- **Test:** plain `vttest hw avc1 1920 1080 60` (no injection): VideoToolbox lists only
  `org.nvenc.videoencoder.avc`, uses it, 60/60 frames decode, 20.1 Mbit/s for 20, 53.9 dB. Metal comes up as before.
- **Not done yet:** Parsec. `parsecd` is in `NVMTL_NVENC_FORCE`, so it gets our encoder the next time it starts, but
  restarting it would drop a running remote session, so that's left to the user. ffmpeg isn't installed in the guest
  (no Homebrew on Intel).
